name: effects-figma-masked-reveal
exporter: Figma (desktop, 2024) - Export > SVG, Include "id" attribute ON, Outline text OFF
story: A lower third built as a soft wipe: plate, accent bar and both text lines sit inside one group masked by a gradient-filled rect, so the banner fades out at its right edge - and the bound text is inside the mask with everything else.
idioms: no XML declaration - Figma writes none
root as width="1920" height="1080" viewBox="0 0 1920 1080" fill="none" xmlns=..., in that order, with no xmlns:xlink
zero indentation - every element flush left on its own line
layer names on wrapper <g> elements (id="Reveal", id="Banner") and the frame name on the outermost group
root frame wrapped in clip-path="url(#clip0_41_218)" with the clipPath declared in a trailing <defs>
mask id pattern mask0_41_218 with style="mask-type:alpha" maskUnits="userSpaceOnUse" and explicit x/y/width/height
the masked content wrapped in an id-less <g mask="url(#mask0_41_218)">
gradient id pattern paint0_linear_41_218, declared in <defs> AFTER the content that references it
stop-color="white" spelled as a keyword, and stop-opacity="0" for the fade
text as <text ...><tspan x="190" y="838.352">…</tspan></text> - one tspan per line, fractional baseline
fill="white" as a keyword, font-weight="bold" / "500", letter-spacing="0em" written even when zero
family names without the face suffix (font-family="Archivo" + font-weight="bold"), the opposite of Illustrator
whyThisMatters: The bound nodes are two levels inside a mask, so an importer that walks only the visible top-level tree finds no fields at all, one that flattens or drops the mask loses the fade the design is built on, and one that offers grow-x here widens the plate out from under a mask that does not move - the text runs into the fade and then off its edge, so the honest answer for a masked stage is shrink.
